 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. KANSAS CITY, Mo. -- The Kansas City Current is headed to the semifinals of the 2026 NWSL Playoffs, and even though they aren't playing at home, there are still plenty of opportunities to immerse yourself in the action.
 On Sunday at 2 p.m., the No. 4 seed Current will face top-seeded Gotham FC at Icahn Stadium on Randall's Island in New York City.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement  Teal Rising: More Kansas City Current stories on FOX4  
 Because the team will be out of town, Current Landing -- the district outside of CPKC Stadium -- is inviting fans to its official semifinal watch party.
 The match will be broadcast on the big screen outside of the home pitch, giving fans the opportunity to gather and cheer on the Current as they compete for a spot in the championship match.
 Attendees can expect to see multiple photo opportunities, popcorn, Current-branded tattoos, pre-game and post-game coverage, live music and kid-friendly activities.
 Gates open to the watch party at 1 p.m. Tickets are free, but you must reserve a spot online. Click here for more information .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Additionally, Providence Pizza and Revel, two newly opened restaurants at Current Landing, will be open during the match, as well as the Pitchside trailer. Carryout will also be available during the match. Additional food and beverages can be purchased at the Current Landing concession stand. Outside food and beverage will not be allowed.
